# opencode-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf

> OpenCode plugin that lets an AI agent control a Kitesurf browser engine over CDP — 28 `surfbird_*` tools, one isolated browser per agent session. Works with the self-hosted surfbird distribution (raw/auth) and upstream Kitesurf. Shares the host-independent `src/cdp/` core with the DSH sibling plugin.

## Key facts

- Package: `opencode-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf` on npm (Apache-2.0, Node >= 22.18 for the CLI, ESM)
- Repo: https://github.com/terry2010/opencode-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf (created alongside this file)
- Install: `opencode plugin add opencode-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf`, or local path in `opencode.json` `plugins`
- Config: plugin `options` in opencode.json (`endpoint`, `token`, `tokenFile`, `requestTimeoutMs`, `keepaliveMs`, `maxSessions`, `idleEvictMs`, `screenshotDir`, `debugLog`) with env fallbacks `SURFBIRD_URL`/`SURFBIRD_ENDPOINT`/`KITESURF_URL`/`KITESURF_ENDPOINT` and `SURFBIRD_TOKEN`/`KITESURF_TOKEN`
- Session isolation: one WS connection = one isolated browser per OpenCode session; `session.deleted` destroys it
- Tools: 28 `surfbird_*` tools (tabs, navigate, snapshot/ax, click/fill/type, wait, evaluate, find/extract/links, screenshot/pdf, console/network, webmcp, cdp passthrough, status)
- Engine limits: no JS dialogs, file upload/download, clipboard, drag/touch, complete keyboard events
- `src/cdp/` is host-independent shared core (zero host-framework imports) — kept in sync with `dsh-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf`

- [surfbird](https://github.com/terry2010/surfbird) — self-hosted Docker distribution of Kitesurf
- [kitesurf](https://github.com/cloudflare/kitesurf) — upstream Cloudflare browser engine (Boa + DOM shim, not Chromium)
